features.description: Native goose Desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows, installed via download, Homebrew or package managers.
Full command-line interface with consistent flags for sessions (--session-id), schedule jobs (--schedule-id), recipes, extensions and configuration.

Rust runtime components behind goose (state machine, operations, providers, tools, context management) to build agents that run in apps, servers and the browser and resume from saved state; Python and Kotlin bindings.

Block donated goose to the Linux Foundation Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), co-founded with Anthropic (MCP) and OpenAI (AGENTS.md) in Dec 2025; repo moved to the aaif-goose org in April 2026; Apache-2.0 licensed, written in Rust.
Runs on your machine for code plus research, writing, automation and data analysis; 56.8k stars, 700+ contributors.
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, Bedrock, AI/ML API, Z.AI and more via API keys, or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider; Ollama models are auto-detected in the model dropdown.
Use existing Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini subscriptions by delegating to ACP agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) running as goose providers, with goose extensions passed through as MCP servers.
goose works as an ACP server so Zed, JetBrains and VS Code can run it as their coding agent (installable from the Zed ACP Registry).
All tools come via MCP extensions: 70+ documented extensions, configured in YAML or enabled in Desktop/CLI, plus a community extension directory.
Extensions can render interactive UIs (buttons, forms, visualizations) directly inside goose Desktop.
Built-in analyze extension (on by default) tracks symbols, usage and call graphs (incoming and outgoing calls) across many languages.

Four modes: Completely Autonomous, Smart Approval (risk-based auto-approve of low-risk actions), Manual Approval and Chat Only; set per session via /mode or as the default in Settings, with granular tool permissions.
A silent independent agent reviewer watches tool calls before execution, catching compromised, injected or off-brief actions with contextual understanding.
Pattern-based detection of malicious instructions hidden in content, such as attempts to delete system files.
Sandboxed execution listed among goose security controls alongside injection detection and permission controls.
Start, switch between and resume sessions; the Desktop sidebar lists your 10 most recent sessions and the CLI supports --resume and --session-id.
Automatic conversation compaction (with manual compaction), context-limit strategies, maximum turns, token usage, credit balance monitoring and cost tracking.
Supply project context via .goosehints, AGENTS.md or custom filenames so goose understands requirements and executes tasks effectively.
Reusable instruction and resource packages that teach goose specific tasks, from checklists to detailed workflows with scripts and templates; built-in Skills platform extension is enabled by default.
Spawn independent subagent instances to handle tasks in parallel (code review, research, file processing), keeping the main conversation clean; goose can create them autonomously.
Reusable YAML or JSON configs that package instructions, extensions, parameters and subrecipes; create in Desktop, share with a team and run in CI.
CLI supports schedule job identifiers (e.g. daily-report) for recurring automated runs.
config.yaml (macOS/Linux: ~/.config/goose) sets default behaviors, models, tool permissions and extensions; goose configure wizard and environment variables supported.
Environment-variable observability configuration including Langfuse integration for tracing goose sessions.
Build your own goose distro with preconfigured providers, extensions and branding.
A Sept 2026 repository commit adds live voice conversations to the desktop app; not yet documented in the docs map, so treat as unverified.
